title: Crumpets With Whipped Seaweed and Masago Caviar Butter Recipe
ldName: Crumpets with whipped seaweed and masago butter
ldKeywords: masago caviar, masago caviar recipe, crumpet recipes, seaweed butter recipes, easy
ldIngredientsRaw: 50g of masago, plus more for topping
ldInstructionsRaw: Soften the butter at room temperature for at least 30 minutes
Whip the butter on high speed for 5 minutes, or until well aerated and creamy in texture
Reduce the speed to incorporate the milk and seaweed, then turn up the speed and whip for another 5 minutes
Use to top the crumpets, adding more masago, if you like
